## Fixed

- Fixed model search reporting `unsupported_tool_workflow` when a response contained both tool calls and a final answer.
- Fixed model search rejecting some Chat Completions answers after the stream finished normally. If the provider reports an error such as insufficient quota before sending any answer text, the CLI now shows the cause.
- Fixed model search removing `<think>` tags and their contents from code examples and dropping answers that consisted entirely of source links.
- Fixed `setup` failing to preselect “Keep current tools” when tools were already configured and the user chose a custom model endpoint.
- Fixed `setup` unexpectedly changing the selected protocol when the user kept the current URL.
- Fixed the CLI reporting cancelled target selection as an error during Skill installation, update, or removal. It now shows a single cancellation message.
- Fixed Exa and Firecrawl rejecting page URLs beginning with uppercase `HTTP://` or `HTTPS://`.
- Fixed `exa search` and `exa fetch` repeating the page text in Markdown when a highlight matched it exactly. JSON retains the original highlight.
- Fixed `--output` resetting read, write, and execute permissions when overwriting a file on POSIX systems.
- Fixed malformed HTTP error bodies masking a known failure reason. Error details now report both.

## Changed

- Search, page retrieval, site link discovery, and documentation lookup now share a Markdown layout. Headings separate sources and pages. Each excerpt and multiline summary has its own code block so headings in the original text cannot start a new result section.
- In web search JSON, `summary` replaces the preview fields `snippet`, `description`, and Tavily's `content`. AnySearch and DeepSeek renamed their page body field from `content` to `text`.
- Setting `UNISEARCH_CONFIG_PATH` to an empty string now yields `INVALID_CONFIG`. If `setup` saves the configuration but Skill installation fails, it now reports `PARTIAL_FAILURE` (exit code `6`).
- Matching provider and CLI error messages appear only once. Markdown and terminal output omit the separate timeout scope line. JSON error details retain `timeout_scope`.
- `exa search --search-type` and `providers.exa.search.search_type` are no longer limited to the four preset search modes.
- `exa search --published-after` now preserves sub-millisecond precision.
- `tavily search --time-range` accepts `d`, `w`, `m`, and `y` as short forms of `day`, `week`, `month`, and `year`.
- Clarified command help and argument errors in English and Chinese.

---

## 修复

- 修复模型搜索在响应同时包含工具调用和最终回答时误报 `unsupported_tool_workflow` 的问题。
- 修复模型搜索将部分正常结束的 Chat Completions 流式回答误判为无效的问题。服务在开始返回正文前报告额度不足等错误时，CLI 会显示具体原因。
- 修复模型搜索误删代码示例中的 `<think>` 标签及其内容，以及丢失仅含来源链接的回答的问题。
- 修复已配置模型搜索工具时，在 `setup` 中选择自定义地址却未默认选中「保持当前工具配置」的问题。
- 修复 `setup` 在沿用当前地址时意外更改已选协议的问题。
- 修复安装、更新或移除 Skill 时将取消选择误报为错误的问题。现在只显示一次取消提示。
- 修复 Exa 和 Firecrawl 拒绝以大写 `HTTP://` 或 `HTTPS://` 开头的网页地址的问题。
- 修复 `exa search` 和 `exa fetch` 在摘录与正文完全相同时重复展示正文的问题。Markdown 现在只显示一次，JSON 仍保留原始摘录。
- 修复 `--output` 在 POSIX 系统上覆盖文件时重置原文件读、写和执行权限的问题。
- 修复 HTTP 错误响应体格式无效时丢失已知失败原因的问题。错误详情现在会分别报告失败原因和格式错误。

## 变更

- 搜索、网页读取、站点链接查询和文档检索采用统一的 Markdown 排版。不同来源和页面用标题分隔，摘录和多行摘要各自放入代码块，避免原文标题打断结果结构。
- 网页搜索结果的 JSON 摘要字段统一为 `summary`，取代原有的 `snippet`、`description` 或 Tavily 的 `content`。AnySearch 和 DeepSeek 的正文字段由 `content` 改为 `text`。
- 将 `UNISEARCH_CONFIG_PATH` 设为空字符串时，CLI 报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`。若 `setup` 已保存配置但安装 Skill 失败，错误码改为 `PARTIAL_FAILURE`，退出码仍为 `6`。
- 服务返回的错误消息与 CLI 提示相同时只显示一次。Markdown 和终端输出省略单独的超时范围行，JSON 错误详情仍保留 `timeout_scope`。
- `exa search --search-type` 和配置项 `providers.exa.search.search_type` 不再限于四种预设模式。
- `exa search --published-after` 现在会保留时间戳中超过三位的小数秒。
- `tavily search --time-range` 支持将 `day`、`week`、`month`、`year` 分别简写为 `d`、`w`、`m`、`y`。
- 完善中英文命令帮助和参数错误提示。
